extracted.name: Pimento Cheese BLT
extracted.description: This delicious Pimento Cheese BLT sandwich has pimento cheese spread on the bread before stacking with bacon, lettuce, and tomato to create the ultimate BLT! It's flavorful, easy, and so crave worthy!
ingredient_lines: 10 slices bread* (, we like Sarah Lee Artesano)
2 heirloom tomatoes (, or other good quality tomato, sliced)
instruction_lines: Cook bacon. Add to a skillet over low heat and cook, turning often, until crisp on both sides. Remove to a paper towel lined plate.
Assemble: Toast bread until golden. Spread bread slices with a layer of pimento cheese. Top with bacon, lettuce and tomato and apply top slice of bread to make a sandwich.
